reviews.comment: Took her for MATH136 (wasn't a selectable option). Basically a review of highschool geometry. Pretty easy. Gives fill in the blank notes. 1 quiz per week, 2 lowest are dropped. 1 homework per week, you get 6 attempts at each question before points are deducted. 3 exams and 1 cumulative final which can replace your lowest exam. Good at explaining.

I took her for MATH136 (wasn't a selectable option for some reason). She's good at helping you understand the reason behind formulas, making it easier to remember them instead of just memorizing. Homework every week, but you get multiple attempts at a question before points are taken off. She gives fill in the blank notes for lectures. Very easy!
Not respectful.

Dr. Carter is great! Exams are worth almost 80% of your grade so if you do not do well with those, I would consider a different professor. Her exams are definitely not easy, and no one has broken through to get a 100 this whole semester, but her lectures are great and easy to follow. Attendance is required and there are 12 quizzes (2 get dropped)

She knows math but can't teach diverse learners. She claims to give partial credit and respect accommodations but doesn't follow through. Despite my 3.8 GPA, I failed because she's inflexible with office hours and penalizes excused absences for health. Many students drop or fail her multiple times. Save your money and take this at Blinn. Avoid her!

Take another professor if possible. Personally, she comes across as not a good professor, not clear on notes and grades, ridiculously hard she deducts for literally anything she can. I would take another professor. Grade averages are like 70s on tests in her class. This should be a easy class as well.

I loved taking MATH 136(which, for some reason, isn't an option to select here) from Dr. Carter; it was so easy! She made fill-in-the-blank notes that we went through in class with practice problems throughout, which created engagement with the information! I also loved the connections between the math we were learning and how to teach it to kids!

I have never dropped a college class, and I'm a junior. However, this class is awful, and I had to drop. Professor Carter is very passionate about math, and that is awesome. However, she gives a lot of tests back-to-back. She says that she gives partial credit, but she does not. You have to memorize every formula. She will not honor accommodations.

She is nice and really tries to help you. However her tests are hard and there is lots of long homework assignments. She uses the textbook for homework problems. Attendance isn't mandatory but you will get behind if you skip class. If you can take this class with another professor!

DO NOT TAKE HER if you could take another math teacher literally do it. Takes too long to grade assignments and gives you too much homework that takes over 4 hours to do at least 2 times a week. Does not give extra credit
Is a good professor, she loves math. But I really struggle with her course. She makes so easy stuff into a more difficult stuff. A lot of homework that takes me 3-4 hours to complete each.

Professor Carter is great! I love her. She does a great job at explaining things! You should know that extensive work has to be shown on quizzes and tests but she makes that very clear from the beginning. The material you cover in this class is pretty basic but you focus more on how to teach it and explain it.

I took Dr. Carter for Math 365 & 366! She is an amazing professor who is passionate about math and her students. She is great at answering clarifying questions and I found her classes engaging and very equipping for teaching math! She's great & it is an easy class if you keep up with the homework and lectures.
Haven't taken test yet, but very caring during office hours.

i struggled real bad in this class. dr carter is a really kind lady but the way she chooses to explain concepts and how she lectures was very difficult for me. not embarrassed to say that i failed and am retaking this class again with a different prof.

Although Professor Carter is clearly passionate about math, I feel she makes this class way too complex than need be.  Pretty much everything she grades is based on accuracy.  3 exams, about 12 quizzes, and 20 homework's.  Even if you complete the hw, you might still end up with just a 50 if you get the problems wrong she chooses to grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's a decent professor who genuinely cares about her students. However, she often spent time teaching unnecessary or overly basic concepts while skipping over important or challenging topics. 8/10 times she would run out of lecture time, leaving half of the homework material unexplained and requiring us to figure it out independently.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Carter made math so fun! I was worried going into this class, because I've never been a math person, but her lectures and guided notes are so helpful. Her office hours are extremely helpful. YOU NEED TO GO TO CLASS! If you miss it is hard to catch up. Do the homeworks too they help the most.

I love Dr.Carter! Her class is definitely not easy. She expects a lot from her students but she is so helpful outside of class. Do all the daily grades it will help your average in the end. This is a class that you can not cram. Attend as many office hours as possible. She'll make time for you. Math 365 is hard but not impossible.

I love her! She is a great teacher and prepares you well for every assignment! She's willing to help if you ever need it. You have to pay attention in class and do the assignments to do well on the tests. Understand concepts! There are three tests (including the final), two projects (essays for tutors), and 50 daily grades (highest 25 taken).

Best math teacher I have ever had. Very accessible outside of class, uses manipulative and other teaching strategies to help all different kinds of learners. No surprises and you know what is expected. Homework is actually helpful not mindless. I am taking her again for mAth 366 because she was so good!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Such an easy class, you basically just learn to count, add, subtract, multiply, and divide. Prof is nice and teaches well but can be annoying. If you found math 140 easy, you will be bored in this class. Prof will make the formal explanations sound hard but they are not. It is basically a group project; explaining math in essay format.

3 exams, 2 Formal Explanations, 50 homework assignments but only top 25 are for a taken. Class is a lot of work but going to class helps with understanding the material. It's a hard class but she's always there to help. She really cares about students and the subject and I would definitely recommend taking her!!

I loved Professor Carter! You need to go to class to get the notes but she is very good at explaining things and you can tell she is passionate about what she is teaching. She was accessible and wanted to help you understand. Tests were not too difficult. The formal explanations were lengthy but you could get a good grade if you were detailed.

3 exams, 3 Formal Explanations, 25 homework grades. Class is a lot of work and you have to go to class. You have to apply yourself and put in the work in order to get a decent grade, but Dr. Carter is an amazing professor.

I loved this class and professor! You definitely have to work hard to get a good grade but she is very caring and will help you. The class consists of 3 tests (including a final that replaces the lowest test), 3 papers, 50 quizzes/homeworks (lowest 25 are dropped). As long as you attend class and do all the units homework, you can get a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I have taken Dr. Carter for 366 and 367 and she is truly an amazing professor. Her class is not easy and you have to be ready to put in the work for a good grade, but she does not make it impossible. Do the EPP problems to prepare for the exams and go to office hours. Dr. Carter wants to help and will never make you feel bad for asking questions.

Dr. Carter teaches well but moves quickly. She is always willing to answer questions though! She tries to get to know her students before class starts each day. She will make you calculate your average yourself all semester, and this class is very test heavy, so watch out. Lots of homework, but only half of it will be graded.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She loves math and all you have to do are these like 4 questions little quizzes before class, but they honestly take 2 minutes max to do. She does class notes which is helpful and the exams are not hard. There is homework but it's only due the night before each exam and they're not cumulative. Loved her taking her for Math 366.

AMAZING!! Dr. Carter is so caring and really makes herself available to help. I suggest going to office hours if you are ever confused. You do have to work for your grade, but if you do the textbook problems and study the notes you should be fine. There is a group project within the class, but she doesn't grade them too hard.

Sweet professor who truly cares for her students. Class was very engaging and you can tell she really loves her students and math. The tests can be challenging, so I recommend going to tutorials on subjects you have trouble with. Very helpful professor willing to answer any questions inside and outside of class. She is very sweet in her tutorials.

Such an amazing professor. This is a fast-paced course, but Dr. Carter does a great job of explaining the concepts. Decent workload but manageable, and there are so many resources to help you understand the material. She really cares about her students and is super passionate about math; I would definitely recommend her!
Really nice and she is very passionate about math. Points are given for attendance and the final replaces the lowest test grade.

She is a very passionate teacher and is always willing to answer any questions. The work outside of class is pretty heavy but as long as you attend lectures and start things early it is very doable. To get an A, just attend every class to not miss instruction, do the homework early, do the practice exams and study.

Professor Carter is really sweet and caring, but probably don't miss class because it moves pretty fast and there are a few group quizzes throughout the course as well. The class goes back and forth throughout modules in a way, so I suggest doing the WebAssign homework earlier than later.

Was really thoughtful and really cares about her students. I read other reviews but I don't know why others are giving here poor feedback. Ive not failed not one test nor have been close to failing one, she throughly cares. Attendance is NOT mandatory BUT if you want to pass I highly recommend you go, I never missed a class and I that helped a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This was the worst class I have ever taken at A&M. Save yourself to take these classes at Blinn. Carter teaches math in the worst way possible and we will never use it in the classroom. I took 366 at Blinn and learned so much and was way more confident with myself! Trust me! Save yourself from misery!! Take both anywhere else!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is made unnecessarily hard for no reason. The material in general is easy basic middle school math but she makes it seem so much more difficult. No hw just daily quiz. Test are just weirdly formatted with no reviews. Recommend doing suggested hw & getting a solid group for projects. But would take at a community college if possible.

Liked her as a person but definitely not a professor. Not allowed to see overall grade which is super annoying. No homework, just daily quizzes that were hard and trick questions half the time. Definitely do suggested hw b/c examples in notes dont do much justice. This class is SO much harder than it really needs to be.

Dr. Carter was caring, thoughtful to give great feedback on previous exams and formal explanations. The only downside to this class from my perspective was that we had to work in groups for our formal explanation papers because getting stuck with less than awesome group members made this class harder than it needed to be for me personally.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you have to take Prof Carter, my best advice to you is to make as many friends as you can in this class. Even if you understand the material she is an insanely hard grader and it can be super demeaning to your ability to do basic math. I would recommend taking this course at a community college if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I LOVE HER! Attendance isn't mandatory but idk how you would catch up if you don't go. The class isn't difficult if you know basic math. There isn't homework, but the suggested homework is SO helpful. Dr. Carter is kind and never makes anyone feel stupid EVER. Worst part are group papers, but they really aren't bad. Find good people near you day 1
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class isn't as bad as the reveiws make it sound. The group papers are the worst part, but once you get the hang of it they are easy. The tests were not a big deal at all as long as you study and do the textbook problems. Prof Carter is super passionate about math, and is always willing to help.

This class is a breeze, but she hides every grade total on canvas. This makes it impossible to know what your grade is and its a little stressful :( Easy group projects and extremely straightforward exams. Use the reviews!! Very simple class if you understand basic math.

The class is not too hard to keep up with, and Professor Carter genuinely cares for her students. She is very fair, and won't give you some extra help because she treats every student the same. The tests are based exactly on the notes you take in class. Although attendance is not mandatory, there's no way you'd pass tests without going to class.

I was intimidated by Dr. Carter's reviews before I took her but LOVED her. She has high expectations of us and is tough, but as future educators, she is preparing us well. She is caring, very willing to answer questions, and excellent at explaining the topics. I was often frustrated by the nature of group work for our papers, but I learned a ton.

Professor Carter is a solid professor. Her class really helped me gain insight on what I need to know to teach elementary mathematics. Study the textbook practice problems and review her notes and youll ace every test. Formal explanations can be tricky, but come to class and take good notes and youll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: As much as I love Prof Carter as a person and her personality in class, this class is unreasonably hard for no reason. The homework's are optional, however I highly recommend doing them or you will struggle very much. Also, do not take this class at 8am, made it even worse!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I LOVE Dr. Carter! She is so good at explaining the "why" behind math and she is super passionate about it too. Some people complain that she's a harsh grader, but I've found that if you elaborate and go to office hours (she's always available), you will do fine. Don't procrastinate the Formal Explanations b/c they're a big part of your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The worst
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Carter was really sweet and extremely caring, especially during COVID-19 (the class was moved online due to the pandemic). The class was more heavy on your test grades, so definitely study the material she gives you. She is very clear and concise in lectures and will always answer your questions!

Your grade is based off of 3 test including the final (60%) Daily Grades (20%), and 2 Formal Explanations (20%). She grades EXTREMELY Hard!!! I have had a tutor all semester and am still barely passing. DO NOT take her!!! I recommend taking at another college. She will waste your money due to having to drop or RUIN your GPA!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Carter, is a nice lady, but when it comes to teaching especially during a pandemic ( online) she lacks empathy and the ability to effectively teach online. Dont get me wrong she's always available for office hour to help, but even when I went to office hour, I failed to understand the material, because her teaching style is just not the best.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great professor. Do not listen to those that say she is not caring or empathetic. She is always available for office hours and is willing to help. She does want things to be done a certain way, but that is literally what the course is about. Really understand the material by studying on your own and doing the homework. I would take her again.

Prof carter is so cute because it is so obvious how much she loves math. The homework is not taken for a grade but she posts it to use for practice for the test. Tests are proctored but they aren't bad. I would definitely take her again as she knows what she is talking about!
Professor Carter is nice but I would never take her again with the online format or during a pandemic. She is a very hard grader, not willing to accommodate, and non empathetic.

She is a nice lady but, the class itself is hard. She is a tough grader & this could kill your grade. The concepts themselves are not that hard however, she wants you to show your work exactly the way she wants and if it is not how she wants it you will get major points taken off. Tough grader. Not impossible just hard. Go to office hours!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: SHE IS A GREAT PROFESSOR! This is my second class I have taken by her and she is amazing. Do the homework and go to office hours. It isn't an easy grade but it is worth it. She makes is possible if you try.

This was the best math course I've taken! Attendance is not mandatory but you should show up to hear her lectures. They are clear, she answers ALL quetion (even ones that seem self explanatory) and she goes at a slow pace. There's homework assigned but is not graded. I did all the units homeworks a few days before the exam- the PERFECT review!
SHE IS THE BEST. Take her for sure. You have homework that is not taken up for a grade but is helpful. If you pay attention you got it! She's so sweet. Go to office hours.

Prof Carter is definitely a great professor. Do your hw because it will help you on the tests and even group projects. She explains everything thoroughly and her expectations are clear. The book is in the library so you technically don't need to purchase it, but you will need it for homework. She gives note outlines.

She is the nicest professor I have ever had and really cares about her students. Has lots of office hours and is always willing to help. Do the test corrections if you want to get bumped, DEFINITELY, do the optional homework before the tests. Can be a difficult class but if you try and pay attention it is doable. 100% recommend her.

Professor Carter is an amazing teacher and person!e If you want to ensure a good grade in her class go to office hours if you have any questions with the homework (homework is not a grade, but HIGHLY recommend to prepare you for the exams), rework the notes prior to exams, and make sure your formal explanations are clear and covers the rubrice

She is the best!! She is so caring and kind and wants her students to succeed. She lectures the whole time but gives time to talk with partners and its not boring. Three tests, noncumulative final, two group papers that are not hard, and optional but helpful homework.

Really sweet and helpful professor. I am terrible at math and I managed to get a B in her class with help from her office hours and reasonable effort. If you're skeptical about taking her for Math140, don't be.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Ms. Carter is super sweet. Class can get boring, but not too hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This woman is precious. I had her for MATH140 in Fall 2018 and it was an awesome experience. Overall it is not a bad class difficulty wise, and her fantastic lecturing makes it worth your time to come to lecture. I attended a lot of her office hours at the beginning of the semester and those are great for homework help and awesome one on one time.

Such a sweet prof. Print the notes & appreciate what you learn in class as you will teach it someday. I recommend doing the homework as soon as you finish the section so that you understand the material. 3 exams, final is not cumulative, and 2 papers explaining concepts. Homework is not a grade, but it is the test review so I recommend doing them!
Professor Carter is GREAT! She is extremely helpful during office hours and wants you to succeed. She gives a lot of quizzes, but they definitely boost your grade if you work hard.
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Carter is super sweet! If you go to her office hours she more than willing to help. Only con is that she gives frequent quizzes and she gives them at the end of class after you just learned new stuff so its kinda hard to go backwards for the quiz.

Carter is THE BEST!! SO kind and so helpful. 140 is really easy for me. Some kids struggle but i learned most of the stuff in HS. She uploads print out notes onto howdy and makes things simple. Take carter if you can! She is so sweet

I'm in her class right now! Such a sweet prof. Very nice and cares that we learn. I ask a lot of questions in class and she never makes me feel like I'm dumb for asking. She picks a row to fill in a reading assignment every week. Notes are printable and you have to fill them in. Study, do homework, and ask questions. You'll be fine if you do!

Professor Carter is probably my favorite prof I have had in all of college. She is genuinely concerned about each student and their success. I seriously cannot say enough amazing things about her. I struggle with math and she made it so easy to understand. LOVE LOVE this class and her!

I loved have Dr. Carter as my MATH 365 prof. She's very passionate about what she teaches and cares about her students. I recommend taking her class. I've had friends say they didn't like her, but I enjoyed her class very much. The class is not hard if you apply yourself and tests aren't that bad.

This math class is not your typical math class... It is just different. You have 3 tests, and 2 formal explanations. She is super helpful and helps you fix everything. The first test will be a little tough, but the feedback from it will help you on the next ones. She is so caring and sweet and passionate about math.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Carter is the sweetest lady. She cares very much about her students and the material. If you pay attention and take notes in this class, you should have NO problem. Go to office hours if you have ANY questions at all, homework or tests and she will help you out. She's like being taught by your mom and is a great instructor.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Carter was by far one of my favorite professors of my entire college career. She is very passionate and she makes every concept crystal clear. I am not good at math, and I do not enjoy math very much, however her classes and lectures taught me a lot and I enjoyed her class thoroughly. I highly recommend Dr. Carter's class to anyone.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Would take again

reviews.comment: Carter is so very caring and patient towards students, even those who arent particularly mathematically inclined (like me). Online homework, quizzes and tests in class. No cumulative tests. The math itself isnt at all hopelessly hard, but obviously it was still nice having a prof who was so helpful.

Carter is so sweet! She does a good job at teaching and provides detailed notes each lecture! There are many quizzes throughout the semester but no pop quizzes! None of the exams are cumulative! This class was fairly simple! Her office hours are also really useful if you are confused about something!

A difficult class because it is unlike any other math class you have ever taken. The 3 tests make up 75% of your grade and there are some group projects but they aren't too bad. Her personality takes a couple classes to get used to but she really does love the subject and her students! Study with friends before the tests.

Professor Carter is a sweetheart who really wants her students to succeed. She takes the time to answer any questions you have when she goes through the notes. Her office hours are extremely helpful when studying for tests.  The tests themselves are not too bad. Study your notes and complete the homework, which is optional. Would take again!

Dr. Carter is an EXCELLENT Prof. She cares about her students and will do virtually anything to help you understand the topic. Her class isn't hard if you put in the work. I would take her again in a heartbeat if I could!!!

This class is a little hard, even though it's basic math, because you have to learn how to explain basic concepts. Dr. Carter makes it really easy to understand, and she's pretty flexible, so it isn't hard to do well.

If you listen to lecture and study the notes before the test you should be fine. I am not good at math and did fine. She is extremely sweet and wants you to succeed. Classes were dull and long, however, tests were over the basic material. Probably would have done better if I did the suggested homework, but I never had time for it.

Prof Carter is so sweet! She posts notes online & fills them out during class. She sometimes moves slowly through the sections, but it is only because she is taking her time to make sure that everyone understands the material. She is available during office hours & is very encouraging. There is usually a quiz after each section & hw due each week.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: There's 3 group notebook explanations. Two assignments due each class period that are pretty easy. She is SO nice and a good teacher. Go to class. Attendance matters. Make sure you do the suggested homework and ask questions before the tests. Final is not accumulative (blessed).
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Carter was awesome! She is a really great teacher and always is willing to help you if you're in need. She makes everything really clear. She really cares about her students and wants them to do well. She's the nicest lady ever, and her class wasn't easy but it wasn't hard. Easy B, if not an A with fairly minimal work. One HW and quiz a week.
I love Mrs. Carter! She is such a sweet lady and is willing to help you outside of class. The exams were mostly free response but I liked that better than multiple choice bc you get partial credit!
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: AWESOME prof. Took some getting used to because she was almost toooooo sweet at first but once I realized how much she genuinely cared about me and what I learned, I adored her. She is a great model of what a future math teacher (or any teacher) should be like. Tests are tough but fair. Projects and daily HW give good chance to raise grade.

She is very willing to help and explain things to you if you don't understand. She is very passionate about the subject! I'm terrible at Math and this was the first math course I took at A&M so the tests were a little difficult for me. However the project and homework grades are very easy! Overall an easy A if you put the work into it.

This is by far the greatest math teacher I've ever had. She is always willing to stay in the office with you for hours until you understand the material. She makes class and material extremely clear and tries to make the class enjoyable. Her tests are just like the notes she makes. It's a really cut and dry course what's on the notes is on the test

I loved Dr. Carter's class, and I'm not even really a math person! She makes things easy to understand and gives tons of examples. If you go to class (there are pop quizzes), do the online HW, and study a little, it's an easy A. She even drops your lowest quiz and homework grade from the average.
